svg.aria-label: The framework's two sites in Azure: a chat, from the domain to the model
svg.title: The framework's two sites in Azure: a chat, from the domain to the model

g.text: The framework's two sites in Azure: a chat, from the domain to the model
a CNAME to the app's own address
a cold start if nobody was on it
POST /v1/sessions as its Orbi, no key:

text.tspan: DNS points a name at its app, the app wakes if it was asleep, the open door lets the visitor
talk to its Orbi, and the answer streams back from the model.
